blocks.text: Semiconductors aise maddey hain jo sirf khaas halaat mein bijli guzarte aur roshni, hararat aur voltage se mutasir hote hain. Yeh khoobiyan inhein jadeed electronics mein ahem banati hain. Conductor aur semiconductor mein farq yeh hai ke semiconductor mein current ko zarurat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai.

Sab se aam semiconductor silicon hai, jo bohat kaarguzar aur wafir hone ki wajah se microchips aur solar panels mein use hota hai. Mobile SIM card silicon chip hai jis ke saath copper connectors jaise chhote hisse hote hain; silicon device mein data guzar, mehfooz aur process kar sakta hai. Gallium arsenide (GaAs) 5G internet devices jaise wireless rabte mein, aur gallium nitride (GaN) electric gariyon ki tez charging mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Bijli ki taron par ceramics insulators ke taur par kyun use hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Porcelain jaise ceramics bijli nahi guzarte, is liye current taar se sahare (support) tak nahi pohanchta; yeh sakht, hararat se mehfooz aur kimiyai taur par be-asar bhi hain, is liye bahar der tak chalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Microchips aur solar panels ke liye silicon kyun pasand kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bohat kaarguzar semiconductor hai jis ka current control ho sakta hai, aur yeh wafir hai.

blocks.prompt: Composite materials mein reinforcement agents kya dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada mazbooti; matrix unhein apni jagah thame rakhta hai.

items: Semiconductors khaas halaat mein conduct karte; current control ho sakta.
Si: chips, solar panels, SIM; GaAs: 5G; GaN: tez charging.
